I have successfully prevented VLC Media Player from auto-closing once a video ends. 

**Solution Applied:**
I accessed VLC's Advanced Preferences (Tools > Preferences > All settings) and navigated to Interface > Main interfaces > Qt > Playlist settings. There, I located the "Play and exit" option under the "General playlist behaviour" section. This checkbox controls whether VLC automatically closes after video playback completes.

**Current Status:**
The "Play and exit" option is unchecked, which means VLC will now remain open after videos finish playing instead of automatically closing. This setting has been saved to VLC's configuration and will apply to all future video playback sessions.

The issue has been resolved - VLC Media Player will no longer auto-close when videos end.
